    def test_scenario(self):
        """Scenario: initial state, mode distribution over time, all modes exercised."""
        import pandas as pd
    
        simulation_data = pd.read_csv('/root/simulation_results.csv')

        assert simulation_data.iloc[0]['ego_speed'] < 1.0
